fulltext: IT之家 11 月 18 日消息，据广东广播电视台报道，小米创办人、董事长兼 CEO 雷军 11 月 17 日出席 APEC 工商领导人峰会，现场社交发名片。网友调侃“不管身价多少亿，该发名片还得发！”
雷军还在峰会上发言，表示具身智能机器人肯定是一个巨大的产业机会，它的想象力会超过汽车产业。小米特别看好 AI 走向物理世界以后带来的空间和想象力，这给整个亚太经济会带来巨大的机会。
IT之家注意到，雷军个人微博还晒出了一张照片，是他在台上参加峰会时，给台下朋友们拍的一张合影。
IT之家注：2026 年 APEC 工商领导人峰会 11 月 17 日至 18 日在深圳举办，主题为“共促繁荣，共赢未来”。来自亚太经合组织（APEC）21 个经济体和英国、法国、德国、瑞士等 13 个域外经济体的 2000 余位政商界代表齐聚深圳。

cards.title: 谷歌钱包登陆苹果 iOS 系统，暂不支持非接触支付
cards.summary: IT之家 11 月 18 日消息，谷歌公司今天宣布，Google 钱包应用程序已在美国登陆苹果 iOS 系统， 用户可在此一站式管理购物记录 、 门票和登机牌等 。 IT之家了解到，iOS 版 Google 钱包支持与 Gmail 等谷歌应用自动同步，获取物流信息、电子登机牌、演唱会门票等数据。用户还可用手机摄像头扫描实体会员卡、健身房会员卡等，将其电子化。 同时，该应用还支持线上结账等功能，用户可在一个安全的平台上轻松查看和管理订单确认信息、收据及配送更新。 不过需要注意的是， iOS 版 Google 钱包暂时不支持非接触支付功能 。

fulltext: IT之家 11 月 18 日消息，据科技媒体 The Verge 今天报道，微软 CEO 萨提亚 · 纳德拉在一场圆桌讨论中表示，自己如今已成为“AGI 信徒”（AGI-pilled）。
IT之家从原报道获悉，纳德拉表示：“我之所以相信 AGI，是因为我们需要在经济层面思考，围绕 AGI，政治经济体系将会形成怎样的组织结构？”
不过这名 CEO 认为，Claude 这类前沿 AI 模型并没有意识。他认同微软 AI 负责人苏莱曼的观点，即企业不应为 AI 模型赋予权利，也不应该将它们视为可能具有道德地位的存在。
苏莱曼此前曾表示，Anthropic 团队已经陷入“自我催眠”状态，并警告称这种做法非常危险。纳德拉对此没有那么笃定，他认为 AI 行业现在最重要的是社会问题，需确保经济体系能广泛普及 AI。

fulltext: IT之家 11 月 18 日消息，NVIDIA（英伟达）当地时间昨日宣布在今年 10 月宣布的合作基础上进一步深化同供应链伙伴的关系，支持人工智能基础设施建设。
根据最新公告，英伟达将向中国台湾地区半导体封装基板制造商景硕 (Kinsus) 投资超 10 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 66.8 亿元人民币）现金，购买设备支持景硕桃园幼狮厂的扩产计划，目标将该厂的先进 ABF 封装基板扩大 3.5 倍以上。
景硕幼狮厂新产能预计 2027 年下半年开出，2028Q3 达产。如果仍然不足，英伟达计划继续参与景硕后续的产能扩充计划，目标至少在 2030 年前掌握稳定产能。
英伟达还修改了与三星电机 (SEM) 的现有基板供应协议，以提高现有工厂的运营能力，从而支持 NVIDIA 加速计算平台的增产。
此外，鸿海董事长刘扬伟表示：“鸿海将继续深化与英伟达在下一代 GPU 和网络平台方面的合作。凭借其覆盖亚洲、北美、欧洲的全球一体化生产网络，鸿海完全有能力支持下一代人工智能基础设施的量产。”

cards.title: Not even Sam Altman is safe from AI deepfakes on Instagram
cards.title_cn: 即使 Sam Altman 也无法免受 Instagram 上的 AI 深度造假的影响
cards.summary: 【The Verge】Instagram is filled with people posting deepfaked content - including, as of late, from one of Meta's most prominent executives. Earlier in November, Alexandr Wang, Meta's chief AI officer, shared a s…
fulltext: Meta’s chief AI officer posted an AI video of a top competitor. It’s allowed under Meta’s AI policy.﻿
Instagram is filled with people posting deepfaked content — including, as of late, from one of Meta’s most prominent executives.

Earlier in November, Alexandr Wang, Meta’s chief AI officer, shared a short clip to promote Muse, the company’s consumer AI agent. In the AI-generated clip, Wang, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, and Jolly, the anthropomorphic mascot of Muse, are on a four-way video call. When Altman joins the call he’s dressed like Jolly, wearing a furry hooded suit and face paint to look like the cutesy character. The clip is captioned “When the homies meet about openai product strategy,” a reference to the AI agent race and the recent popularity of Muse.

Just a few years ago, AI content portraying real people led to strong public statements rebuking the use of the technology to imitate humans. In some cases legal action was threatened. Now, AI content has become part of the texture of a new reality, especially on social media. Leading up to the midterm elections, for example, political groups ran millions of dollars’ worth of AI-generated ads attacking opponents.

Wang has been doing a lot of what some have described as “anti-PR” to promote Muse, tweeting hundreds of times and referring to more traditional marketers as “corposlops.” Still, a major tech executive posting an AI video of a competitor is notable, especially on a platform that’s been criticized recently over AI-generated content. After an AI-generated image of actress Mia Goth gained traction in October, the Pearl star’s representative told The Verge it was “incomprehensible” that Instagram allowed the image to spread instead of focusing on the “protection and integrity of a public figure’s likeness.” Other celebrities, including Scarlett Johansson, are regularly the subject of sexualized AI imagery; Meta has removed some accounts in the past that it found to be posing as someone else and using their likeness.

Meta requires AI-generated videos depicting people to be labeled as AI, like Wang’s post is. Static images, however, have no such requirement, meaning the AI image of Goth had no disclosure. To make matters worse, the image was shared by a fan account with a blue verification badge given by Instagram.

Reached for comment, Meta spokesperson Tracy Clayton noted that Wang’s post is labeled as AI content. Clayton also pointed out that Altman has made his likeness available for AI content generation, as when OpenAI launched its Sora app (and it was quickly flooded with fake Altman videos). OpenAI didn’t respond to requests for comment.

fulltext_cn: Meta 的首席人工智能官发布了一个顶级竞争对手的人工智能视频。 Meta 的人工智能政策是允许的。﻿
Instagram 上到处都是发布深度造假内容的人，其中包括最近来自 Meta 最著名的高管之一的内容。

11 月初，Meta 首席人工智能官 Alexandr Wang 分享了一段宣传该公司消费者人工智能代理 Muse 的短片。在 AI 生成的视频中，Wang、Meta 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格、OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼以及 Muse 的拟人吉祥物 Jolly 正在进行四方视频通话。当奥特曼加入通话时，他打扮得像乔利，穿着毛茸茸的连帽套装，脸上涂着颜料，看起来就像这个可爱的角色。该剪辑的标题是“当兄弟们见面讨论 openai 产品策略时”，指的是 AI 代理竞赛和 Muse 最近的流行。
就在几年前，描绘真人的人工智能内容引发了强烈的公开声明，谴责使用该技术来模仿人类。在某些情况下，威胁要采取法律行动。现在，人工智能内容已经成为新现实的一部分，尤其是在社交媒体上。例如，在中期选举之前，政治团体投放了价值数百万美元的人工智能生成的广告来攻击对手。

为了推广 Muse，王做了很多被一些人称为“反公关”的事情，他发了数百条推文，并将更传统的营销人员称为“corposlops”。尽管如此，一位主要科技高管发布竞争对手的人工智能视频还是值得注意的，尤其是在一个最近因人工智能生成内容而受到批评的平台上。 10 月份，人工智能生成的女演员米娅·高斯 (Mia Goth) 的一张照片受到关注后，这位珍珠明星的代表告诉 The Verge，Instagram 允许这张照片传播，而不是专注于“公众人物肖像的保护和完整性”，这是“不可理解的”。其他名人，包括斯嘉丽约翰逊，经常成为性感人工智能图像的主题。 Meta 过去删除了一些发现冒充他人并使用其肖像的帐户。
Meta 要求人工智能生成的描绘人物的视频被贴上人工智能的标签，就像王的帖子一样。然而静态图像没有这样的要求，这意味着哥特的人工智能图像没有泄露。更糟糕的是，这张图片是由一个带有 Instagram 提供的蓝色验证徽章的粉丝账户分享的。
Meta 发言人特雷西·克莱顿 (Tracy Clayton) 联系我们寻求评论时指出，王的帖子被标记为人工智能内容。克莱顿还指出，奥特曼已经将他的肖像用于人工智能内容生成，就像 OpenAI 推出其 Sora 应用程序时一样（很快就充斥着假奥特曼视频）。 OpenAI 没有回应置评请求。

cards.title: Satya Nadella says he’s AGI-pilled now
cards.title_cn: 萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella) 表示，他现在已经被 AGI 占据了
cards.summary: 【The Verge】Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says he's AGI-pilled, at least when it comes to how AI might make startling changes to the structure of the economy and how politics might change because of it. "I am AGI p…
fulltext: But he doesn’t think Claude is conscious.

Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says he’s AGI-pilled, at least when it comes to how AI might make startling changes to the structure of the economy and how politics might change because of it. “I am AGI pilled in the sense that at an economy level, what is the political economy’s organization around AGI?” he asked at a roundtable discussion following his Microsoft Ignite keynote at the Chase Center in San Francisco.

But Nadella doesn’t think frontier models like Claude are conscious. “I don’t think so,” he said, adding that he follows Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman’s view that companies should not give rights to models and treat them like they might have a moral status, which companies like Anthropic do as a matter of principle. Suleyman has told me he thinks Anthropic’s team has “wireheaded” themselves, and that this approach is dangerous.

Nadella wasn’t quite as firm about it. “It’s a good debate,” he said. “I’m not sort of dogmatic about it. What I’m saying is the most important social technical issue we have to deal with is how do you ensure that an economy can diffuse this technology broadly?”

I asked Nadella how he was thinking about AI after hearing his response to another reporter’s questions about Anthropic releasing more products in its office suite. Nadella talked at length about the potential collapse of the economy and the end of democracy if one AI model were allowed to achieve monopoly status.
“If the Marxist sort of view is that there’s only one firm, then it’s over, right? For all of us.”

“Most people think about this as a competition between tech firms, which of course it will be,” he said. “But remember, the model has no limits. It’ll be a healthcare company. It can be a financial services company. It can be anything if it wants to be. It can take over the government. Thinking of this as some narrow competition between tech firms, of who is going to get to the next trillion dollars of market cap, is one of the strangest, narrowest ways to think about it.”

Nadella went on to say that the very nature of companies stood to be disrupted in the future. “If intelligence has network effects, what is the future of a firm?” he asked. “If the model sees anything and learns it, and essentially all of human capital collapses into token capital, what is the role of a firm and the human capital in a firm? That’s the debate.”

“I think the political economy is going to get more and more interesting in that context. No one — at least in a democracy — can even win an election if this just goes that way, if there’s only capital and there’s no labor. I mean, I don’t know, that’s not an economy.”
“If the Marxist sort of view is that there’s only one firm, then it’s over, right? For all of us. Not just for me. You are also going to somehow be some affiliate of Anthropic.”
Needless to say, this is not how tech CEOs usually talk about the launch of competing spreadsheet software.

Of course, Nadella was also promoting Microsoft’s various AI tools at Ignite, which promise to let enterprise clients pick the most cost-effective models for various tasks, run their own models, and control their own data in different ways. The idea here is that the market will demand many different kinds of models and sovereign data in order to keep control from centralizing, a theme Nadella kept coming back to as we spoke.
“I think that if you believe that the world, the economy needs more than one firm or two firms, then by definition there need to be as many models as firms of some sort,” he said.

cards.summary_cn: 【The Verge】微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella) 表示，他对 AGI 很着迷，至少在人工智能可能如何对经济结构产生惊人的变化以及政治可能因此而发生变化时是这样。 “我是AGI...
fulltext_cn: 但他不认为克劳德有意识。
微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella) 表示，他对 AGI 充满信心，至少在人工智能可能如何对经济结构产生惊人的变化以及政治可能因此而发生变化时是如此。 “我是 AGI 的受害者，在经济层面上，围绕 AGI 的政治经济学组织是什么？”他在旧金山大通中心的 Microsoft Ignite 主题演讲后的圆桌讨论中问道。
但纳德拉并不认为像克劳德这样的前沿模型是有意识的。他说：“我不这么认为。”他补充说，他遵循微软人工智能首席执行官穆斯塔法·苏莱曼（Mustafa Suleyman）的观点，即公司不应赋予模型权利，并像对待他们可能具有道德地位一样对待他们，而像 Anthropic 这样的公司则将其视为原则问题。苏莱曼告诉我，他认为 Anthropic 的团队已经“头脑简单”了，这种做法很危险。
纳德拉对此并没有那么坚定。 “这是一场很好的辩论，”他说。 “我对此并不教条。我想说的是，我们必须处理的最重要的社会技术问题是如何确保经济体能够广泛传播这项技术？”
在听到纳德拉回答另一位记者关于 Anthropic 在其办公套件中发布更多产品的问题后，我问纳德拉他如何看待人工智能。纳德拉详细讨论了如果允许一种人工智能模型获得垄断地位，经济可能会崩溃，民主也会终结。
“如果马克思主义的观点是只有一家公司，那么一切都结束了，对吗？对我们所有人来说。”
“大多数人认为这是科技公司之间的竞争，当然事实确实如此，”他说。 “但请记住，这种模式没有限制。它将是一家医疗保健公司。它可以是一家金融服务公司。如果它愿意的话，它可以是任何东西。它可以接管政府。将其视为科技公司之间的某种狭隘竞争，谁将达到下一个万亿美元的市值，是最奇怪、最狭隘的思考方式之一。”
纳德拉接着表示，未来公司的本质将被颠覆。 “如果情报具有网络效应，那么企业的未来是什么？”他问道。 “如果模型看到任何东西并学习它，并且基本上所有人力资本都崩溃为代币资本，那么公司和公司中的人力资本的作用是什么？这就是争论。”
“我认为在这种背景下，政治经济将会变得越来越有趣。如果这样下去，如果只有资本而没有劳动力，那么没有人——至少在民主国家——甚至可以赢得选举。我的意思是，我不知道，这不是一种经济。”
“如果马克思主义的观点是只有一家公司，那么一切都结束了，对吗？对我们所有人来说。不仅仅是我。你也会以某种方式成为 Anthropic 的某个附属公司。”
不用说，这并不是科技公司首席执行官通常谈论推出竞争性电子表格软件的方式。
当然，纳德拉还在Ignite上推广了微软的各种人工智能工具，这些工具承诺让企业客户为各种任务选择最具成本效益的模型，运行自己的模型，并以不同的方式控制自己的数据。这里的想法是，市场将需要许多不同类型的模型和主权数据，以防止控制中心化，这是纳德拉在我们讲话时不断提到的主题。
“我认为，如果你相信世界经济需要的不仅仅是一两家公司，那么根据定义，某种类型的公司就需要有同样多的模型，”他说。

While not always the case, when you use AI, it’s fairly safe to assume that companies are using your data to train their models. It’s the trade-off you often have to be comfortable with if you want to use these products. However, Google is now updating the Gemini app to give users a new option.

In a brief blog post, Google announced it is giving you more control over when your Gemini chat history is used for generative AI training. The update will introduce new settings that will let you opt out of training while keeping your chat history. Additionally, you’ll still be able to control how long your history is stored and review or delete history manually.

With the introduction of these new settings, Google says training is set to off by default. History is also toggled off by default. However, if you are interested in helping the company improve its models, you can follow these steps to turn these settings on:

Along with this rollout, Google is also making a change to how long history is saved. If you have history turned off, your future conversations will be saved for around two months. Google says this update will be available globally in the coming weeks.

cards.title: Gemini can now handle task requests for free, including calls to businesses on your behalf
cards.title_cn: Gemini 现在可以免费处理任务请求，包括代表您致电企业
cards.summary: 【Google】TL;DR Google expands Tasks to call businesses on a user’s behalf, schedule appointments, and make purchases. Users can also text and email tasks to Gemini outside the app. Tasks is now free in six cou…
fulltext: Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
Google is turning Tasks in Gemini from a feature that was only for paid subscribers into something that’s free, while also expanding Tasks to let Gemini act as a more independent assistant.

Gemini Tasks started life as Gemini Spark back in May and got a name change just last month. With this update today, it can call businesses on a user’s behalf, schedule appointments, and make purchases. It can also do these things outside of the app, with the ability for people to email or text Gemini.

In a blog post, Google Labs Vice President Josh Woodward gave examples of some of the ways that he’s used Tasks himself. Woodward said that when his minivan’s check engine light came on, he tasked it with scheduling a service appointment, which it did by calling two nearby dealerships and finding an appointment time that matched up with his availability on Google Calendar. Woodward said he also used Tasks to analyze what had caused an unusually high electric bill and to purchase a USB-C charger for the best price.

Woodward said there are guardrails for Gemini acting maybe a little too independently when it comes to purchasing and handling sensitive information. Users can set a budget, and Gemini requires human approval before giving out payment or private account info. Receipts and tracking information will be viewable in Google Wallet. Credit card points and protections are still in place when Gemini is used for transactions.

There is one potential hiccup Tasks could face when interacting with businesses. On the call with the car dealerships, Woodward said Gemini disclosed that it was AI and that business can opt out of such interactions. That’s something they’re increasingly doing, with Amazon blocking Meta’s Muse from shopping on its site, as reported by GeekWire, and United Airlines announcing a policy to restrict AI agents from accessing its platform.

Tasks is now free for everyone in the US, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia, and India. To have Gemini handle tasks for you, open the app, on the home screen toggle from Chat to Tasks, and then prompt Gemini with what tasks you need done. You can also give Gemini tasks by emailing it at gemini.google.com or texting it. To set up texting, open the Gemini app, go to Settings > Channels > Text with Gemini > Set up and then verify your phone number.

谷歌正在将 Gemini 中的任务从仅适用于付费订阅者的功能转变为免费功能，同时还扩展了任务，让 Gemini 充当更独立的助手。
Gemini Tasks 早在 5 月份就以 Gemini Spark 的名字诞生，并于上个月更名。通过今天的更新，它可以代表用户致电企业、安排预约和进行购买。它还可以在应用程序之外执行这些操作，让人们能够向 Gemini 发送电子邮件或短信。
在一篇博文中，Google 实验室副总裁 Josh Woodward 举例说明了他自己使用 Tasks 的一些方法。伍德沃德说，当他的小型货车的检查引擎灯亮起时，他要求它安排一次服务预约，它通过致电附近的两家经销商并在谷歌日历上找到与他的空闲时间相匹配的预约时间来实现这一点。伍德沃德表示，他还使用 Tasks 来分析导致电费异常高的原因，并以最优惠的价格购买 USB-C 充电器。
伍德沃德表示，在购买和处理敏感信息时，双子座的行为可能有点过于独立。用户可以设置预算，Gemini 在提供付款或私人帐户信息之前需要人工批准。收据和跟踪信息将在 Google 电子钱包中查看。使用Gemini进行交易时，信用卡积分和保护仍然有效。
在与企业交互时，Tasks 可能会遇到一个潜在的问题。伍德沃德在与汽车经销商的电话会议上表示，Gemini 透露这是人工智能，企业可以选择退出此类互动。据 GeekWire 报道，他们越来越多地这样做，亚马逊阻止 Meta 的 Muse 在其网站上购物，联合航空公司宣布了一项限制人工智能代理访问其平台的政策。

任务现在对美国、日本、韩国、加拿大、澳大利亚和印度的所有人免费。要让 Gemini 为您处理任务，请打开应用程序，在主屏幕上从“聊天”切换到“任务”，然后提示 Gemini 您需要完成哪些任务。您还可以通过发送电子邮件至gemini.google.com 或发短信来向Gemini 分配任务。要设置短信，请打开 Gemini 应用程序，转至设置 > 频道 > 与 Gemini 发短信 > 设置，然后验证您的电话号码。
